scripts.dev: bun -e 'const c = Bun.JSONC.parse(await Bun.file("wrangler.jsonc").text()); delete c.routes; await Bun.write("wrangler.dev.json", JSON.stringify(c))' && wrangler dev -c wrangler.dev.json
scripts.check: bun run types >/dev/null && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p cli && tsc --noEmit -p web
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/fonts && bun build cli/bin.ts --target=node --outfile=dist/cli && bun build web/view.ts web/compose.ts web/hl.ts --minify --outdir=dist && cp web/bin.css skill/bin/SKILL.md dist/ && mv dist/SKILL.md dist/skill.md && cp cli/install.sh dist/install && cp public/* dist/ && cp node_modules/geist/dist/fonts/geist-sans/Geist-Variable.woff2 node_modules/geist/dist/fonts/geist-mono/GeistMono-Variable.woff2 dist/fonts/ && test "$(ls -A dist | tr '\n' ' ')" = 'bin.css cli compose.js favicon.svg fonts hl.js install llms.txt skill.md view.js '
